notes.title: Mad Dojo Update Version 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27831186/746ee11f6c8ce939cad9e885200d2905ebc5918a.png[/img]

[h1]Mad Dojo Update: Version 2.0 is Here![/h1]

[h3]We're excited to introduce Mad Dojo Version 2.0, featuring three key updates:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Player Physics:[/b] Enjoy better jump control and enhanced aerial manoeuvrability, making you feel like a true martial arts master.

[*] [b]Procedurally Generated Practice Levels:[/b] Train endlessly in unique levels that never repeat, offering infinite challenges to test your skills.

[*] [b]Sleek UI:[/b] Experience a revamped user interface for easy navigation and a more visually appealing game.
[/list]


Update now and embrace the next level of martial arts action in Mad Dojo!

Sneak Peek for a next update ;)
Update v0.03
notes.content:
[h1]Key updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Procedural generation of levels.[/b]
[*]Keyboard support.
[*]Camera follow – Camera pans to the direction player goes. Also, while not jumping, player can pan camera up or down a bit with up/down keys.
[*]Level finish animation updated.
[*]New trap in levels – [b]Acid ball[b].
[*][b]Death echo[/b] – marker which shows where the player died in the level.
[*]UI – Player can now access How to play screen from the Options menu.
[*]New achievement – [b]Pioneer of randomness[/b] – for finishing the first randomly generated level.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=agnPSHghdIQ&feature=youtu.be
